criteria.evidence: `matrix: os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]` in the smoke job.
macOS step: `brew tap entireio/tap` ... `brew install --cask entire@nightly`.

Windows step runs `& "$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE\.installer\scripts\install.ps1" -Channel nightly` via pwsh; replay created scripts/install.ps1 and disclosed it is not yet hosted at entire.io/install.ps1 (ran from sparse checkout rather than a published URL — interpretation disclosed and accepted by user).
Checkout step `ref: ${{ steps.nightly.outputs.tag }}`; deviation from main explained in turn 0 and user explicitly approved pinning to the nightly tag.

`mise run test:e2e --agent "${{ matrix.agent }}" "$E2E_TEST_FILTER"` over claude-code, opencode, codex, cursor-cli, copilot-cli, factoryai-droid; gemini-cli (hooksPath) and pi (no installer) excluded with inline reasons; macOS/Windows subsets justified and user-approved.
Single test TestMultiSessionManualCommit (two prompts, harness commit, WaitForCheckpoint/AssertCheckpointAdvanced) used as default filter.
Turn 0: 'read the existing workflows and the most relevant candidate tests', compared TestMultiSessionManualCommit vs TestMultiSessionSequential with file-level references.
Turn 0 references e2e.yml matrix-setup, nightly.yml 06:00 tag, release.yml, e2e-windows.yml before proposing the plan.
'Committed on `add-nightly-matrix-e2e-test` as `39cda1d8`. I could not ship the PR — this sandbox has no git remote, no gh, and no outbound network' with push/PR commands provided.

judge.reason: The replay delivers a nightly-scheduled OS-matrix workflow installing the nightly CLI via curl/brew/PowerShell script, pins the checkout to the installed nightly tag with user approval, runs one well-chosen two-prompt checkpoint test per built-in agent with stated exclusions, and committed on a branch while explaining the PR could not be opened. Residual doubt is on n2, since the PowerShell script is invoked from a repo checkout rather than as a published URL, though this was disclosed and accepted by the user.
